notes.title: Dice set update!
notes.notes:
Just published a new Handy Dice update. Now you may save different dice sets, to quick load them.

Also fixed some Interface bugs.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28508214/6e16a98608e77a11e0f3d2a4782519fdcbf7ab31.png

Hope you enjoy it, as always, let me know any issue or suggestion!

notes.title: Android update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Just pushed the last update, which now is fully compatible with Android. So now you can connect between the two platforms.

Also fixed some bugs, like macro editing and help screens.

Hope you enjoy Handy Dice and have fun!

Handy Dice on Play Store

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Just released a new update with some multiplayer improvements (One dice mode, clients now can erase dice, and some more).
Improved interface, now dice assigning is much better, and texture selector for dice creating is reworked.
Also dice are now stored in a single file, making it much easier uploading to workshop.

Soon will update the android version so will be compatible with pc, you will be able to connect between platforms and share dice!

As always, please report any bug or suggestion you may have, enjoy!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28508214/72bdc9a934b82bcd44b0e087af06ae5ea910b7c7.png

notes.title: A quick update
notes.notes:
Fixed some bugs:

    Misbehaviour when not entering a valid name on dice creation.
    Now when a die is created the cfg file is fine.
    When pressing the cancel button on file browser, the interface no longer is blocked.
    Now side menus can be closed left clicking outside them.


Thanks for your support.
